To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a pointwise mutual information (PMI) layer can be used to integrate image level and point-wise annotations, (ii) PMI can be combined with the cosine loss to ease the learning process, (iii) PMI can help to improve the results for weakly supervised detection and (iv) a Spatial Pyramid Pool layer (SPP) can be used to combine coarse point-wise labels with image-level labels.
the combination of a cosine loss with pointwise mutual information improves object localization and weakly-supervised object detection.

(1) a cosine loss can be used in a non-categorial embedding space, (2) pointwise mutual information improves the accuracy of a network, and (3) point-wise annotations can be used to improve the accuracy at minimal annotation costs.
